warnings: Raise visibility first (debug pass): increase scene exposure or flame/emission intensity until the wick, candle rim, and flame silhouette are clearly readable in a single frame.
Fix DOF: set the focus plane on the flame core/wick and reduce blur so the flame core is crisp while background books fall into bokeh (not the entire subject).
Improve flame shading/colors: drive color by temperature/blackbody (blue-white at hottest inner core, then yellow/orange) and ensure flame is emissive enough to light nearby wax/brass.
Reduce smoke density drastically for a clean-burning candle; aim for delicate wisps. Then add higher-frequency detail (noise/vorticity) so smoke forms thin curling filaments, not a blob.
Increase volumetric sampling / reduce denoising blur to preserve fine smoke detail and avoid blotchy volume artifacts.
Recompose so the flame and top of candle occupy the visual center of interest; ensure at least the wick and a small portion of the holder are in-frame to convey scale.

Add/strengthen local light interaction: ensure the flame contributes visible warm highlights on brass and subtle subsurface-like glow on wax (even if approximated), plus gentle shadowing/contact lighting.
